title: Coral and the Cipher
author: Astrid Amberdale
blurb: Ansel Hartwell, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
